rule: Only evidence public before context_cutoff is used. Referee/stadium/kickoff are metadata unless a validated historical effect model exists.

context.evidence: Tigres was 8W-3D and unbeaten in 11 league meetings vs Juárez; won all four Clausura 2025 home matches; 13 straight Liga/Liguilla home matches unbeaten; seven goals conceded in eight and never more than one conceded in a match.
Nicolás Ibáñez was ruled out with a muscular issue hours before kickoff, removing the nominal number nine.
Monterrey entered after a 3-1 win over Atlético San Luis and was seeking a third consecutive league win.
Sergio Ramos and Óliver Torres did not travel, officially reported as load management in the congested schedule.

fixtures.verdict: MIXED; AVOID USING MONTERREY FAVORITISM AS A STANDALONE CONTEXT CONFIRMATION

context.evidence: Pumas was unbeaten in the five most recent league meetings vs Tijuana (2W-3D); Tijuana had lost five straight Liga MX matches and was the third-worst home team with 3 of 12 available home points.
Pumas came from the capital derby in the prior round on a shorter turnaround; Piero Quispe had been sent off in that match, creating an availability concern.

fixtures.verdict: SUPPORT_MODERATE_PUMAS_OR_TIJUANA_LOW; NOT A BLIND ML CONFIRMATION

context.evidence: Puebla coach Pablo Guede had disclosed that Emanuel Gularte and Luis Quiñones, important pieces in defense and attack, would remain unavailable longer than expected with no return date.

unmodeled_metadata_policy.referee: Record now; no p adjustment until referee tendencies are validated pre-cutoff on historical data.
unmodeled_metadata_policy.stadium: Global home advantage is already in Dixon-Coles; venue-specific surface/altitude remains a candidate future feature, not an ad-hoc adjustment.
unmodeled_metadata_policy.kickoff_time: Record now; no p adjustment until empirical evidence establishes a stable effect.
unmodeled_metadata_policy.h2h: Secondary context only; downweight when managers/personnel/system differ materially.
